name: B10-0093/2024 (PPE) – Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Iraq, notably the situation of women’s rights and the recent proposal to amend the Personal Status Law
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Iraq's parliament to reject a proposed change to Iraq's 1959 Personal Status Law, which covers marriage, divorce, child custody and inheritance. The Parliament says the change could legalise marriage for girls and boys under 18 and allow unregistered marriages finalised by religious leaders. It also says the change would let couples choose religious rules instead of the national law, giving different rights to different sects. The Parliament asks the European Union and its member states to raise these concerns with Iraq.

- The proposal could legalise child marriage and unregistered marriages in Iraq.
- It affects Iraqi women and children, especially girls under 14.
- The European Parliament asks Iraq's parliament to reject it; the outcome is not yet known.
